description: The bar chart illustrates the Recall@10 values for different categories. The categories are listed on the horizontal axis, labeled with "Ours", "- critiquing", "- scoring", and "- ranking" from left to right in a fixed order. The vertical axis is labeled with values ranging from 0.1 to 0.4, with a linear scale and tick labels at intervals of 0.1. The chart displays four bars, each corresponding to a category, with "Ours" represented by a yellow bar and the other categories represented by blue bars. The bar for "Ours" has a value of approximately 0.35, while the bars for "- critiquing", "- scoring", and "- ranking" have values of around 0.29, 0.15, and 0.23, respectively. The bars are not sorted in any particular order other than their fixed categorical order on the horizontal axis, and none of the bars are visually emphasized.
